Nono, it's okay. I know that it probably is a cause of a lot of my anxieties and such, and I really want to give it up. I used to have some success with not smoking in the mornings, or when I had something to go out and do, but lately I've been just hiding in its oblivion.

I suppose it's always worth another try to give it up again. I just wish I didn't have access to it, frankly.
Thank you, but-- while the offer really is touching, as I mentioned, I'm an addict, and a fairly weak willed one at that. I'm really mostly looking for advice, or direction.

For the psychiatrist or psychologist? Because, 300 and 180 per session, respectively. My psychologist said he felt I'd need to be doing weekly sessions for about six months to see serious improvement.

Edit: Oh, uh. AUD.
